'''Asset C-5''' was a member of the [[The Shroud's syndicate|intelligence network]] that served the independent operative known as the [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. C-5 was stationed on the [[CZ-198]] facility to observe the Republic and the Empire's battle for control of the facility.<ref name="State" />
